h1: Nongbua Greenview Hotel — A Hundreds-of-Baht Stay in the Town Centre for Nong Bua Lamphu
intro: If you are driving into Nong Bua Lamphu and just want a clean bed for a few hundred baht, nothing fancy, Nongbua Greenview Hotel is a name locals know. It is a simple resort-style budget stay in Lamphu Subdistrict near Highway 228. Its main draw is the in-town location near King Naresuan Monument and Nong Bua, the lake at the heart of town. Rooms come with air conditioning, a fridge, TV, hot water and free Wi-Fi, plus an on-site restaurant and free parking, from approx. ฿400/night. To be straight from real guest reviews: it is an older property with basic facilities and few online reviews, but the price is good value for a one-night stopover.

body.html: Nongbua Greenview Hotel is a budget property in central Nong Bua Lamphu, set in the Ban Saphan Thong area of Lamphu Subdistrict, Mueang Nong Bua Lamphu, near Highway 228 and about 1.2 km from the district office. What guests agree on is the in-town location near King Naresuan Monument and Nong Bua, the lake and landmark at the heart of town, with easy access to the centre. The overall feel is simple and resort-style with some greenery around the grounds, suited to travellers who just want a quiet bed for a few hundred baht.

Rooms are air-conditioned with a fridge, TV, hot water and free Wi-Fi. There are several options from single and small-double rooms up to a triple room for groups. The design is practical rather than stylish, but it fits an overnight stop while travelling or running errands in the province. Rates start around ฿350-400 for a single/small double and climb to roughly ฿500-700 for larger doubles and the triple, which is very easy on a tight budget.
"Central, convenient and cheap. The AC room was cool, with hot water and a fridge, and parking was easy. Good for a one-night stop on the road. Don't expect luxury, but it's worth the price."

On site there is an a-la-carte restaurant, breakfast service (usually charged separately) and live music on some evenings. Basic services such as free parking, luggage storage, room service and a lounge/bar are all here for a budget property. In a small town like Nong Bua Lamphu, where outside shops close early at night, having a restaurant on site helps a lot if you arrive in the evening.

To be honest from real reviews: the key thing to know is that this is an older property with cleanliness that is acceptable rather than spotless, and the overall score sits around 6.9 out of 10 from a small number of reviews. Some booking listings charge a key deposit of about 100 baht, and breakfast is charged separately from the room. Facilities are basic, with no pool or gym. The fit is really for travellers who prioritise price and location over a picture-perfect stay.

In short, if you want a stay in central Nong Bua Lamphu for a few hundred baht, near King Naresuan Monument and Nong Bua, with AC rooms that include a fridge and hot water plus free parking, Nongbua Greenview Hotel is good value for a stopover or while running errands in the province. It works for drivers passing through, people working in the area and budget travellers. Just understand it is a simple older property with few reviews, compare prices across platforms before booking, and you get the kind of value Nong Bua Lamphu has to offer.

A tip from following reviews here: if you come as a group, ask for the triple room first, since the per-person cost is very low. Check the key deposit and whether breakfast is included or charged separately when you book. And if you arrive late, rest assured there is an on-site restaurant and free parking, so you won't be circling the town looking for a spot.

faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions — Nongbua Greenview Hotel

faq.q: Where is Nongbua Greenview Hotel and what is nearby?
faq.a: Nongbua Greenview Hotel is at 176/1 Moo 3, Ban Saphan Thong, Lamphu Subdistrict, Mueang Nong Bua Lamphu, near Highway 228. It is in town, about 0.5 km from King Naresuan Monument and close to Nong Bua, the lake at the heart of town. The bus station is about 1.7 km away and Udon Thani Airport about 44 km.

faq.q: How much does Nongbua Greenview Hotel cost and what rooms are there?
faq.a: Rates start around ฿400/night for a single/small double. Large doubles/twins are about ฿520 and triples about ฿700. Every room has AC, a fridge, TV, hot water and free Wi-Fi. Prices vary by date and platform, so compare Agoda, Booking and Trip.com before booking.

faq.q: Does Nongbua Greenview Hotel have a restaurant and parking?
faq.a: Yes — there is an a-la-carte restaurant on site, a lounge/bar, live music on some evenings, and free parking. It is convenient if you arrive in the evening and want a hot meal without going into town. Luggage storage and room service are also available.

faq.q: Is there a deposit or free breakfast at Nongbua Greenview Hotel?
faq.a: Some booking listings charge a key deposit of about 100 baht, and breakfast is usually charged separately from the room. It is not included in every rate. Check the details and confirm with the hotel when you book to avoid surprise charges. Wi-Fi is free in the common areas.

faq.q: Who is Nongbua Greenview Hotel best for?
faq.a: It suits budget travellers who want an in-town bed for a few hundred baht, near King Naresuan Monument and Nong Bua. It works for drivers passing through, people on business in the province and anyone prioritising price and location over luxury. For newer rooms or a pool, look at a mid-range hotel in town or a resort on the outskirts.

faq.q: What are the reviews like for Nongbua Greenview Hotel — can I trust them?
faq.a: The overall score is around 6.9 out of 10 from a small number of reviews. Most guests praise the price and location but note that it is an older property with acceptable cleanliness. The overall picture is less settled than at hotels with many reviews, so judge by real photos, location, facilities and compare prices across platforms before deciding.
